meta.title: feat(cache): async log processing with queue
meta.body_summary: Add Redis (Valkey) for async log processing using a message queue: insertLog publishes to queue instead of direct DB insert, and a worker consumes the queue to perform actual DB insertions.

perf_labels.notes: Devin introduced Redis queue to async log processing; maintainer collaborated with additional commits (worker integration, test mocks) before merging without formal review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2875 changed lines across 36 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, but most churn is in lockfiles and test additions. It fits a feature performance PR that decouples logging, merged after collaborative commits by the maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review text exists; maintainer pushed several improvement commits (worker lifecycle, test mocks, Redis backend switch) and merged without formal approval.
review_details.performance_claim: Decouple log insertions from synchronous DB writes using Redis queue to improve response times.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a message queue for async logging is a common backend optimization; the Agent provided the initial structure and the maintainer filled in testing and integration details.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing or load test evidence; only narrative performance claim of async improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Original commit changed insertLog; follow-up fix returned 1 to match test expectations; later commits added worker lifecycle, mock log insertion, and switched from Valkey to Redis before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added Redis client (redis.ts), worker to consume log queue, and modified insertLog to publish to queue instead of direct DB insert. Integrated worker startup in serve.ts and added test utilities for worker integration.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Large churn in lockfiles (pnpm-lock.yaml) and test files; the core change in logging and worker logic is small.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: introduced Valkey queue, Redis client, worker, and modified insertLog.
Devin merged main and fixed insertLog return value to match test expectations.
Maintainer added worker lifecycle helpers, test utilities, and mock log insertion for tests.
Switched from Valkey to Redis backend and cleaned up worker entry point.
Final chores: generated openapi specs, fixed dependencies.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with Redis queue integration.
Maintainer pushed additional commits for worker lifecycle, test mocks, and switched from Valkey to Redis.
No formal review; maintainer merged after ~15 hours.
